## Architecture review

For an implementation change, name the current architecture claim or core
model that would otherwise become false or materially incomplete. If there is
none, write `No architecture update` and briefly explain why. For dedicated
documentation work, name the inaccuracy, core-design gap, or sediment being
corrected.

When architecture changes, confirm that the diff describes the resulting
system without relying on before/after narrative, commit-specific motivation,
or local implementation detail. Where related prose already exists, confirm
that the change revises or consolidates it rather than only appending new
material.
